body.name: Simultaneous multinomial transition region
body.construction: Define \(\mathcal C_{\alpha}\) as the set of controlled kernels \(P'\) with the known zero pattern, \(P'(y\mid x,a)\ge\epsilon\) on positive cells, \(|P'(y\mid x,a)-\widehat P(y\mid x,a)|\le\delta_{x,a}\) for every cell, and some \((g',h')\) satisfying \(r-g'\mathbf 1=h'-K'_{\pi}h'\) and \(\operatorname{span}(h')\le B\).
